binding_note: {{...}} tokens are LIVE DATA BINDINGS. Resolve server-side at render. Never hardcode — rates are set by each independent cleaner and change.

bindings.{{CLEANER_COUNT}}: count of cleaners where status='active' and accepting=1, filtered by the page's zips/specialty
bindings.{{RATE_LOW}}: min(hourly_rate_cents)/100 across that same filtered set
bindings.{{RATE_HIGH}}: max(hourly_rate_cents)/100 across that same filtered set
bindings.{{CLEANER_CARDS}}: render the directory card list for that filter; when empty, render the empty state, NOT a zero

empty_state_rule: When {{CLEANER_COUNT}} is 0, suppress every sentence containing a rate binding and render the join/notify CTA instead. Pages must read correctly with an empty directory.
